name: Stargazer's Lane, Park Entrance
desc1: Stargazer's Lane is named for the Observatory, at the eastern end of
desc2: the street. Nearly as famous to locals as the library. Many years of
desc3: dreams and labor went into building the giant telescope that it
desc4: houses. To the south is a park, that may have once been beautiful. An
desc5: iron trellis arches above the park entrance.
